source_md:
The Book Appointment workflow action lets your workflow automatically create an appointment on a selected calendar when a trigger fires. It’s designed for teams that want to auto‑schedule follow‑ups from events like form submissions, inbound webhooks, or CRM updates—without manual effort.

## **What is the Book Appointment Workflow Action?**

The Book Appointment action enables the creation of new appointments based on specified times and in specified calendars. Users can now configure a Book Appointment action through workflows, which allows appointments to be created based on trigger events. This is ideal for businesses looking to automate appointment bookings through specific triggers.

**Some key points:**

- You must choose a Calendar to receive the booking.
- Team members can be set to Calendar Default (e.g., round robin) or a specific member.
- Dynamic time can be mapped from trigger data (e.g., webhook payloads or form fields). If the incoming format doesn’t match supported patterns, use Date Time Formatter.
- If no one is available (and override is off), the appointment won’t be created.

```
Limitation: Calendars that have 'Recurring' enabled cannot be selected for the 'Book Appointment' action.
```

---

## **Key Benefits of using Book Appointment Workflow Action**

Trigger‑driven scheduling that respects real availability, reduces manual work, and cleanly branches next steps based on success/failure.

- **Efficient follow‑ups** — Auto‑book from forms, chat, or webhooks.
- **Higher conversion** — Lock in time while intent is fresh.
- **Flexible assignment** — Use calendar defaults (e.g., round robin) or pick a specific team member.
- **Reliable logic** — Branch on **Appointment booked successfully** for confirmations, nudges, or fallback actions.

---

## **Setting up the Book Appointment Workflow Action**

Creating a Book Appointment step links your workflow to a target calendar and defines when/with whom the appointment will be created.

### **Step 1:** Go to Automations

Navigate to Automations → Create New Workflow → Start From Scratch. Then add a trigger. Examples: **Form Submitted**, **Inbound Webhook**, or other relevant triggers.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052586842/original/0riEYOvbFN-W1cUn2lcfd4jm7A_8xWP-NA.gif?1756384342)

### **Step 2:** Add the action

Click **Add Action → Book Appointment** and give it a clear **Action name** (e.g., “Book demo with Sales”).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052587208/original/PlSK-h6vSCDjLAUPpKBZr9mgvrSW9O0V5Q.png?1756384481)

### **Step 3:** Choose a Calendar, Team Member, and Set Appointment Date & Time

**Calendar**: Select the target calendar that will receive bookings.

**Team member**:

- **Calendar Default** — follows calendar assignment rules (e.g., round robin).
- **Specific member** — explicitly route to one person.

**Set Appointment Date & Time:**

For dynamic start dates and times, ensure your format is compatible. Use the Date Time Formatter action to convert the date and time format if necessary.

- **Standard** — Fixed date/time for all bookings created by this workflow.
- **Dynamic** — Map date/time from trigger data (e.g., webhook payload, form field, or custom value).
- **Supported formats (examples):**

  - MM-DD-YYYY HH:MM → 12-21-2021 08:30 AM
  - DD-MMM-YYYY HH:MM → 21-OCT-2021 08:30 AM  
      
    If your input doesn’t match a supported format, insert a **Date Time Formatter** step before Book Appointment to reformat.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052589247/original/kB3ftIpttgUl3WnvXJc-OGTR13VAvEksbQ.png?1756385194)

```
IMPORTANT: Override availability —  
  
1. Off: system checks availability before booking.  
  
2. On: book without availability checks (use sparingly).  
  
(Optional) Add Action Description or internal notes if your template includes them.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. Will the action respect calendar availability?**  
Yes, unless you enable **Override availability**.

**Q. Can I branch logic based on success/failure?**  
Yes—add **If/Else** and use **Appointment booked successfully** (True/False) to route outcomes.

**Q. Which date/time formats are supported for Dynamic?**  
See the formats under **Step 5**. If needed, add a **Date Time Formatter** step.

**Q. Can I assign bookings via round robin?**  
Yes—choose **Calendar Default** to follow the calendar’s assignment rules.

**Q. What if the booking fails?**  
Use the False branch to notify the team, create a task, or try an alternate time.

**Q. Any limitations with the Book Appointment Workflow Action?**  
Calendars with **Recurring** enabled cannot be selected in the Book Appointment action.

title_en: Company Object Feature: A Manual Way to Organize Contacts
source_md:
The Company Object feature in HighLevel helps users group related contacts under a shared company profile. This enhances relationship management, contact organization, and activity tracking across teams working with the same client business.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Company Object Feature?](#What-is-the-Company-Object-Feature?)
- [Key Benefits of the Company Object Feature](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Company-Object-Feature)
- [How to Create the Company Object](#How-to-Create-the-Company-Object)
  - [Step 1: Navigate to the Companies Section:](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Navigate-to-the-Companies-Section%3A)
  - [Step 2: Add a New Company](#Step-2%3A-Add-a-New-Company)
  - [Step 3: Enter Company Details](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Enter-Company-Details)
- [How to Edit or Update Company Details](#How-to-Edit-or-Update-Company-Details)
- [How to Delete a Company](#How-to-Delete-a-Company)
- [How to Add Contacts to a Company](#How-to-Add-Contacts-to-a-Company)
- [How to Remove a Contact from a Company](#How-to-Remove-a-Contact-from-a-Company)
- [Automate Contact-to-Company Assignment](#Automate-Contact-to-Company-Assignment)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Company Object Feature?**

The Company Object allows you to associate multiple contacts with a single company entity, making it easier to manage client relationships at the organizational level. This is particularly useful when your team interacts with various people from the same business. By grouping them under one record, you can view collective engagement, centralize data, and improve communication across touch points.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Company Object Feature**

Using the Company Object provides practical advantages for managing contact relationships:

- **Organized Contact Management:** Easily group multiple contacts under one company.
- **Consolidated Activity Tracking:** Monitor interactions and activities related to a company.
- **Enhanced Relationship Insights:** Gain a complete view of how your team engages with an organization.
- **Efficient Communication:**Easily communicate with all contacts linked to a company.
- **Improved Data Accuracy:** Maintain consistent and updated information across company-associated contacts.

---

## **How to Create the Company Object**

Follow these steps to set up a new company in HighLevel:

### **Step 1:**Navigate to the Companies Section:

- Use the main navigation bar on the left to navigate to **Contacts**
- Navigate to the tab labeled **Companies** in the secondary navigation ribbon at the top of the page

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041969865/original/afPxEFXXuOBxnAqTaV3LFBqNvqJ_8oglww.png?1740065034)

### **Step 2:** Add a New Company

- Click on the blue button at the top right labeled **+ New Company**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041969989/original/h0xP2Ge9B26gWwWxU6549DHsoSBCwKFHVA.png?1740065114)

### **Step 3:**Enter Company Details

Enter the company details in the box on the right of the screen. Below are the details you are able to add:

- **Company Name** (mandatory)
- **Phone Number**
- **Email**
- **Website**
- **Description**
- **Address Details** (Street, City, Postal Code, Country)

```
Please Note: Only the company name is required, but adding more details enhances usability.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041970367/original/LbLWS8aCQVKZDC4wUpWeqzJFaU4RmCQzJg.gif?1740065352)

---

## **How to Edit or Update Company Details**

1. **Go to the Company List**

   - Use the main navigation bar to Navigate to `Contacts`
   - Select the `Companies tab in the top navigation bar`
   - Click the **three dots (`...`)** next to the company you would like to edit and choose `Edit Company`
2. **Update Details**

   - Modify any necessary fields.
3. **Save Changes**

   - Click `Save` to apply the updates.

---

## **How to Delete a Company**

1. **Go to the Company List**

   - Use the main navigation bar to Navigate to `Contacts`
   - Select the `Companies tab in the top navigation bar`
2. **Select the Company to Delete**

   - Click the **three dots (`...`)** next to the company you would like to edit and choose `Delete Company`
3. **Confirm Deletion**

   - Click `Yes` to confirm.

```
Note: Deleting a company clears the Company field in associated contacts but does not delete the contacts themselves.
```

---

## **How to Add Contacts to a Company**

1. **Navigate to the Contact's Profile**

   - Use the main navigation bar to Navigate to `Contacts`
   - `Find the Contact you would like to add to the company and click on the contact's name`
2. **Assign the Company**:

   - Select the `Company`**tab** in the secondary navigation bar on the left of the page
   - Search for and select the company.
3. **Save Changes**

   - Click `Save` to update the contact's association.

```
For bulk assignment, select multiple contacts and assign them to a company at once.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045226266/original/hB0MXzNuW4JiT_N6tcQE2IUWCEYF2s689Q.jpeg?1744827285)

---

## **How to Remove a Contact from a Company**

1. **Access the Company Profile**

   - Use the main navigation bar to Navigate to `Contacts`
   - Select the `Companies tab in the top navigation bar`
   - Select the company.
2. **View Associated Contacts**

   - Navigate to the `Contacts` tab.
3. **Remove the Contact**

   - Click the **Trash Bin** icon next to the contact.
4. **Confirm Removal**

   - Click `Yes` to finalize.

*Note: Removing a contact from a company does not delete the contact; it only removes the association.*

```
Automating Company Associations: HighLevel provides automation features to streamline company assignments. Please refer to Company Object Automation
```

---

## **Automate Contact-to-Company Assignment**

You can automate this process based on the "Business Name" field in contacts.  
  
To enable:

- Go to **Settings > Objects > Company**
- Toggle **Automatically Create and Associate Companies from Contact Business Names**

```
Learn more in the article: Company Object Automation
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I assign multiple companies to a single contact?**  
No, a contact can only be associated with one company at a time.

**Q: Will deleting a company removes all its contacts?**  
No, it only removes the company association. Contacts remain in your database.

**Q: Can I bulk assign contacts to a company?**  
Yes, select multiple contacts in the contact list and assign them to a company at once.

**Q: How do I find all contacts linked to a specific company?**  
Navigate to Contacts > Companies, select the company, and view the Contacts tab.

**Q: Can I automate contact-company associations without manually assigning them?**  
Yes, enable Automatically Create and Associate Companies from Contact Business Names in Settings > Objects > Company.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Company Object Automation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001228591)
- [Getting Started with Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003896-getting-started-with-custom-objects?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Importing Contacts and Opportunities via CSV](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003905)
- [Associations for Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004033)
- [Workflow Action - Create Contact](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002685)

title_en: Getting Started - Setup Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads
source_md:
Connect your Facebook and Instagram channels to manage lead generation ads. Capture high-quality leads directly from social media. Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads let you capture prospect information from Meta ads and manage campaign setup directly in HighLevel.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads?](#What-are-Facebook-and-Instagram-Lead-Ads?)
- [How to Setup Facebook/Instagram Lead Ads](#How-to-Setup-Facebook/Instagram-Lead-Ads)
- [Publishing an Existing Ad](#Publishing-an-Existing-Ad)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads?**

Lead generation campaigns can use Facebook lead forms to collect information such as a prospect's name, email address, phone number, or answers to custom questions.

Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads in HighLevel allow you to create and manage Meta lead generation campaigns from **Marketing > Ad Manager**. When form fields are mapped to the appropriate HighLevel contact fields, submitted lead information can be organized in the CRM for follow-up and automation.

---

## **How to Setup Facebook/Instagram Lead Ads**

#### **Step 1:** Open and Activate Ad Manager

Ad Manager must be activated for the sub-account before Meta assets can be connected and campaigns can be created.

1. In the HighLevel sub-account, navigate to **Marketing > Ad Manager**.
2. If Ad Manager has not been activated, click **Activate Ads Manager**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078477956/original/os-WfwWeGuPqqUT2BXo-rUJ8jvS9dCIriA.png?1786726217)

#### **Step 2:** Connect Facebook

1. From the Ad Manager onboarding screen, click **Connect Facebook**.
2. Complete the Facebook login or authorization flow and grant the requested permissions to LeadConnector.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078478030/original/MM6zYytVDK-6souUuz8yukJ0octEcRIt9w.png?1786726295)

#### **Step 3:**Select a Meta Ads Account

1. Locate **Select a Meta ads account** dropdown or search field to find and select the correct ad account.
2. Under the Facebook Page selection area, search for and select the page you want to use. Then click **Connect.**
3. Once the page is connected, click the **Get Started**button.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078478284/original/FRrZ6nzG6F9CmytUvtYpb6wcwlwouuWGAg.png?1786726486)

#### **Step 4:**Create a Campaign

1. Click **+ Create Campaign**.
2. Select **Meta** as the platform.
3. Click **Next**.
4. Choose to start from scratch or use an available Ad Manager template.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078478808/original/3wuI73yvsr9iNfV_RCq1XNdF6CI5lHQJuw.gif?1786726707)

#### **Step 5:** Select the Lead Generation Objective

1. Select **Lead Generation** as the campaign objective.
2. If applicable, select the appropriate **Special Ad Category**. If the campaign does not fall within a special category, choose the applicable not-applicable option.
3. Continue to the ad set configuration.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479094/original/3wwOmLf_wZPrUlmes-oYFUwyn1tjkr55zw.png?1786726987)

#### **Step 6:** Configure the Ad Set

Configure the available ad set settings, including:

- Enter an **Ad Set Name**.
- Select the **Facebook Page**.
- Select an **Instagram Account**, when applicable.
- Choose your **Placements**.
- Set the **Budget** and applicable schedule.
- Configure the **Audience** and location settings.

Meta ad spend is charged through the payment method connected to the selected Meta ads account.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479251/original/SrlKEzkLNLZ_sCxblXNHYT23Na0IRzuY8w.png?1786727074)

#### **Step 7:**Create or Select a Facebook Lead Form

1. At the ad level, select **Facebook Lead Form** when prompted for the lead destination or supported lead capture option.
2. Open the lead form dropdown.
3. Select an existing form or click **Create Facebook Form**.

If selecting an existing form, review its mapping before continuing. When HighLevel indicates that form fields are not mapped, use the mapping prompt to connect the form fields to the appropriate CRM fields.

If creating a new form, select **+ Create Facebook form**then complete all required information to create the form.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479387/original/2kCd5pWR_5wg2oRt7JOxaH0qLXkm58lOwA.png?1786727209)

#### **Step 8:** Configure the Ad Creative

1. Enter an **Ad Name**.
2. Add the **Primary Text**.
3. Add a **Headline**.
4. Add a description when appropriate.
5. Select the desired **Call to Action**.
6. Upload the applicable image, carousel, or video media.

When the campaign is ready, click **Review**,confirm the campaign details then click **Publish Campaign Now**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479525/original/NfQp9H276rjUdLDUsCsxeSPWwtc8ork92A.png?1786727335)

---

## **Publishing an Existing Ad**

Editing and publishing an existing ad is useful when an ad already exists in HighLevel Ad Manager but still needs to be reviewed or published. This workflow allows you to return to the existing campaign configuration rather than creating a new campaign from the beginning.

1. Navigate to **Marketing > Ad Manager**.
2. Locate the applicable ad or campaign.
3. Click the **three-dot action menu**.
4. Click **Edit**.
5. Review the available campaign, ad set, and ad settings.
6. Continue to the final review and publishing stage.
7. Click the applicable **Publish** action and confirm the publication.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078479670/original/aCM80odNOJxd1NifeJsyn5E-esLMyTPYng.png?1786727535)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need a Meta ads account to use HighLevel Ad Manager for Facebook and Instagram ads?**  
Yes. A Meta ads account must be selected during Ad Manager setup before the onboarding flow can be completed.

**Q: Why is the Get started button disabled?**  
The button remains unavailable until the required Ad Manager connection steps are complete. Confirm a Meta ads account has been selected and a Facebook Page shows as connected.

**Q: Why is field mapping important?**  
Field mapping connects Facebook form responses with the corresponding HighLevel CRM fields. Proper mapping helps ensure details such as name, email, phone number, and custom responses are stored in the correct contact fields.

**Q: Can I use an Instagram account with the campaign?**  
Yes, an Instagram account can be selected at the ad set level when available. If an Instagram account is not connected, campaign behavior can depend on the available Meta configuration and selected placements.

**Q: Can Facebook Lead Ad submissions trigger HighLevel workflows?**  
Yes. When the Facebook integration and lead syncing are configured, Facebook Lead Ad submissions can be used with HighLevel automation, including the Facebook Lead Form Submitted workflow trigger.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Get Started with Meta Campaigns in Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003044-how-to-get-started-with-meta-campaigns-in-ad-manager)
- [Ad Manager - Create New Facebook Ad Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002435-ad-manager-create-new-facebook-ad-campaigns)
- [How to create a Facebook form in Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002439-how-to-create-a-facebook-form-in-ad-manager)
- [Connecting Facebook Business Account to Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002434-connecting-facebook-business-account-to-ad-manager)
- [Step-by-Step Guide to Facebook Integration in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001157632-step-by-step-guide-to-facebook-integration-in-highlevel)
- [Facebook Multi Page Lead Ads Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004537-facebook-multi-page-lead-ads-integration)

The redesigned side panel turns a Company into an account workspace you can act from. It brings the Company's fields, associated contacts and deals, appointments, tasks, notes, and conversations into one place, and lets you start a conversation, book or link an appointment, and manage linked records without leaving the panel. The Companies list stays open in the background.

```
Note

This feature is available only through a private beta and applies only to locations where it has been enabled.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Use a Company as an account hub](#Use-a-Company-as-an-account-hub)
- [Open a Company](#Open-a-Company)
- [Review Company details](#Review-Company-details)
- [Switch between tabs](#Switch-between-tabs)
- [Work with Conversations](#Work-with-Conversations)
- [Work with Appointments](#Work-with-Appointments)
- [Book a meeting](#Book-a-meeting)
- [Link an existing appointment](#Link-an-existing-appointment)
- [Record actions](#Record-actions)
- [Frequently asked questions](#Frequently-asked-questions)
- [Editorial checks before publication](#Editorial-checks-before-publication)

---

# **Use a Company as an account hub**

Because each tab lets you take action as well as review, the Company becomes the place your team manages the account from.

- **Account context:** Review the Company's contacts, opportunities, and other associated records in one view before a call or meeting.
- **Follow-up:** Start a conversation with a contact at the Company from Conversations, with the Company already linked.
- **Meetings:** Book a meeting from Appointments with the Company preselected, or link a booking that already exists.

---

## **Open a Company**

- Go to **Contacts → Companies**, then click a Company name.

The Company opens in the side panel. Use the arrows at the top to move to the previous or next Company in the current list. Use **Close** to return to the list.

---

## **Review Company details**

The **Details** tab shows the Company's name, associations, and fields.

- **Associations:** Review linked records grouped by relationship. Use the add control beside a relationship to open its association selector, or **View all** when shown to see more associations.
- **Search fields and folders:** Find a field or folder without scrolling through the full record.
- **Hide empty fields:** Focus on fields that have values.
- **Folders and counts:** Expand folders to find their fields and see the field count.
- **Edit fields:** Click a field value to open its editor.

**Step 1:** Go to Contacts > Companies and click a Company name.

![Step 1: Go to Contacts > Companies and click a Company name.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159009/original/pqrDwriMwCKd8QGEbWrSaqxe8Xtjy3q4bw.png?1792995605)

**Step 2:** Review associations and fields in Details. Use field search and Hide empty fields to narrow the view.

![Step 2: Review associations and fields in Details. Use field search and Hide empty fields to narrow the view.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159006/original/LSUnWhBlGNTcRjzbEj3VoBYQokVn0O6VPQ.png?1792995605)

**Step 3:** Use the icons on the right to switch tabs, such as Associations.

![Step 3: Use the icons on the right to switch tabs, such as Associations.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159007/original/MkEYCbHcHCbVTovJzidCXYdXkGFu09ONUA.png?1792995605)

**Step 4:** Open the three-dot menu to copy the record ID, view audit logs, or delete the record.

![Step 4: Open the three-dot menu to copy the record ID, view audit logs, or delete the record.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159004/original/NVvXWDvaaUHqJW13cLtgtRf8T4IzXYJgoQ.png?1792995605)

**Step 5:** Use the arrows at the top to move to the previous or next record.

![Step 5: Use the arrows at the top to move to the previous or next record.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159008/original/hHehp9IBD1yDdRJcOYUnE-giWsrc0tV5kA.png?1792995605)

---

## **Switch between tabs**

Use the icons on the right edge of the panel:

| **Tab** | **Purpose** |
| --- | --- |
| Details | Review the record's fields and associations |
| Appointments | Review appointments linked to the record, book an appointment, or link an existing one |
| Associations | Open the record's associations section |
| Tasks | Open the record's tasks section |
| Notes | Open the record's notes section |
| Conversations | Review or create conversations associated with the record |

---

## **Work with Conversations**

1. Open the Company and select **Conversations**.
2. Review the conversation feed. If there are no linked conversations, the panel shows an empty state.
3. Click **Create a conversation** or **Create new conversation**.
4. Select a **Contact**. The current Company is already marked **Linked**.
5. Click **Create conversation** to continue.

The Contact is the person involved in the conversation. The linked Company gives the conversation its account context.

**Step 6:** In Conversations, click Create a conversation. The Company is already Linked. Select a Contact and continue.

![Step 6: In Conversations, click Create a conversation. The Company is already Linked. Select a Contact and continue.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159003/original/tZpZmqyVuPAeCnGAK9kT3OxE6GQIDrfPUg.png?1792995605)

---

## **Work with Appointments**

1. Open the Company and select **Appointments**.
2. Switch between **Upcoming** and **Past**.
3. Use **Search by Calendar Name** to find appointments.
4. Click **Add** to choose **Meetings**, **Services**, or **Link existing appointment**.

**Step 7:** In Appointments, click Add, then choose Meetings, Services, or Link existing appointment.

![Step 7: In Appointments, click Add, then choose Meetings, Services, or Link existing appointment.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159002/original/Kh4gtscwaNom_vN8M2dmTosv6yzE56cW5Q.png?1792995605)

---

### **Book a meeting**

1. Select **Add → Meetings**.
2. Choose the calendar, appointment details, date, time, and Contact.
3. Review **Associated objects**. The current Company is preselected.
4. Review the remaining booking details, then select **Book appointment**.

**Step 8:** When booking a meeting, open Associated objects to confirm the current Company is preselected.

![Step 8: When booking a meeting, open Associated objects to confirm the current Company is preselected.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159010/original/kymCDdOkTVUPwVjP3sPKwXbxwTG4uDaE8A.png?1792995605)

---

### **Link an existing appointment**

1. Select **Add → Link existing appointment**.
2. Search for an appointment in the current location.
3. Select **Link** beside the appointment you want associated with this Company.

**Step 9:** To use a booking that already exists, choose Link existing appointment, search, and click Link.

![Step 9: To use a booking that already exists, choose Link existing appointment, search, and click Link.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084159005/original/IpucPfQVJVGZJCR9DPwpU2SeAPV0WxCSgw.png?1792995605)

---

## **Record actions**

Open the three-dot menu at the top of the panel to access **Copy record ID**, **View audit logs**, or **Delete**.

---

## **Frequently asked questions**

**Q: Why is the Conversations tab empty?**

The selected Company has no conversations in its feed. You can start one from **Create a conversation** and choose a Contact.

**Q: Can I link an appointment that already exists?**

Yes. Open **Appointments → Add → Link existing appointment**, search, and select **Link** beside the appointment.

**Q: Why do I need to choose a Contact?**

Conversation creation requires a Contact. The current Company is linked separately to provide account context. The meeting booking form also requires a Contact.

**Q: Does this panel include Opportunity pipeline controls or a Payments tab?**

The Companies panel has six tabs: Details, Appointments, Associations, Tasks, Notes, and Conversations. Opportunity-specific pipeline controls and a Payments tab are not present in this panel.

##

[[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/1NPtdNqkRtc?&wmode=opaque)](https://youtu.be/1NPtdNqkRtc)

**In This Article**

- [Overview](#Overview)
- [How to Restore a Deleted Calendar?](#How-to-Restore-a-Deleted-Calendar?)
- [Important Points to Note](#Important-Points-to-Note)

---

### **Overview**

Users can now utilize the "Restore Calendar" feature to recover deleted calendars along with their appointments. This functionality fills a crucial gap, allowing users to undo their actions with ease.

Whenever you delete a calendar, all its appointments are also deleted. Many times users delete their calendars and then want to recover the deleted calendar. With the restore functionality, you can now restore your calendar as well as any appointments that were deleted with the calendar.

---

### **How to Restore a Deleted Calendar?**

- Navigate to Settings > Audit Logs.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033168218/original/8VenB-Hi6kOYkM1wqsxJgbnfhs_us-EjVA.png?1726746248)

- Identify the log entry corresponding to the deleted calendar.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033168584/original/KWHKUSke_gJuBh8XSmPvQDOfDHLo7gfFCw.png?1726746471)

- Click on the three dots next to the log entry and select "Restore."

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033168878/original/MwroShuUDDYtxjRUgG441XBRLf3DrXn6lw.png?1726746628)

- Your calendar, along with all its previously deleted appointments, will be successfully restored.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033169553/original/BDxNpjemC-gSHk3X5T801yEpqkjvpAg-YQ.png?1726746839)

---

### **Important Points to Note**

- If you've deleted a calendar, all appointments associated with it are also deleted.
- Appointments deleted within ±30 minutes of the calendar deletion time will be restored.
- Any appointments deleted outside of this timeframe will not be recovered.
- Audit logs are retained for a maximum of 60 days. Ensure timely restoration of deleted calendars to avoid data loss.
- **For example,** if you delete a calendar on May 15th at 10:00 AM, all appointments of that calendar will be immediately deleted as well. These appointments are essentially deleted within a timeframe of 30 minutes from the calendar deletion time. When you restore your calendar, all such deleted appointments will be restored. However, if you had deleted an appointment on May 15th at 9:00 AM, that appointment won't be restored.
- This is essentially done to ensure that only those appointments that were deleted as a result of the calendar deletion are restored, and not those appointments that were deleted by the user at another point in time.

## 

## Overview

The "**Google Analytics**" action allows you to fire a custom event in your Google Analytics (GA) account. This action supports Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Universal Analytics (UA). It can be used to track specific user interactions or behaviours on your website or app in GA for better insights.

## Action Name

**Google Analytics**

## Action Description

This action enables you to send custom events directly to Google Analytics (GA4 or UA) by specifying details like the Measurement ID, Event Name, API Secret, and Event Value.

## Action Details

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032467697/original/EPGRuaUplacZu8Hmn3TIPtOaMraBVEhRcg.png?1725821507)

### How to Configure

1. **Action Name**: Set the name of the action (e.g., "Add to Google Analytics").
2. **Action Type**: Select either "Google Analytics 4" or "Universal Analytics" based on your setup.
3. **Measurement ID**: Enter the Measurement ID for your GA4 property.
4. **Event Name**: Specify the event name that will appear in GA4/UA (e.g., "purchase", "page\_view").[Refer here for the event naming rules by google](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/13316687?hl=en)
5. **API Secret**: Input the API secret from your GA4 setup to securely send event data.
6. **Event Value**: Optionally, pass a value related to the event, like revenue or clicks.

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Field Name | Description | Mandatory |
| Measurement ID | The unique ID for your Google Analytics property in GA4 | Yes |
| Event Name | The name of the event you want to trigger in GA4 or UA | Yes |
| API Secret | A secret key generated in Google Analytics to send data securely | Yes |
| Event Value | The value or parameter you want to pass along with the event | No |

## Example

You can use this action to track when a user completes a form submission on your website by firing a "Form Submitted" event in Google Analytics. The Measurement ID will link the event to the correct property, and the API secret ensures the data is securely transmitted.

### 

## Suggested Triggers

- **Form Submission**: Trigger this action when a form on your website is submitted, sending event data to GA.
- **Page Visit**: Trigger the event when a user visits a specific page, like a product page, to track user behavior.
- **Tag Added**: When a user tag is added (e.g., "New Lead"), this action could send an event to GA tracking that change.
- **Appointment Booked**: Fire an event when a user books an appointment to track how many appointments are made through your system.
- **Product Purchase**: Trigger this action when a product is purchased and send relevant information to Google Analytics (e.g., purchase value).

### 

## Additional Notes

- Make sure that Google Analytics is correctly configured in your system before using this action.
- Events sent to Google Analytics can be used for reporting, segmentation, and marketing automation.
- Ensure that the Measurement ID and API secret are accurate for successful event tracking.
